[[File:KarVastor.jpg|thumb|Vibroshields made from ultrachrome]]
'''Ultrachrome''' was a metal used as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] armor around the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Silver and superconductive, it reflected [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] weaponry, was heavily resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks, and was immune to metal-eating fungi.

Ultrachrome's resistance to lightsaber strikes was due to its superconductive nature. When the energy field of a lightsaber interacted with ultrachrome, it would be uniformly conducted across the entire solid mass, rather than be allowed to concentrate in one area and cut through. However, this also entailed that if enough energy from the lightsaber were transferred to the ultrachrome, the entire piece would melt.

[[Kar Vastor]] crafted his [[Akk Guard]] [[vibroshield]]s out of ultrachrome.

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] protected themselves with this metal.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
